description.value: Red Tomato Pies is a BC-born pizza chain founded in Williams Lake by Jason and Amber Akeson, now spanning 11 locations across Western Canada including Golden. The Golden location is takeout-only, specializing in handcrafted pizzas with proprietary sauces alongside sides, salads, wings, and desserts. A touring cyclist stopping in Golden will find a quick, filling meal with plant-based and gluten-free options available.
